name: Wait... You Can Do This? (starter example)
source: catalog starter set — copy this file to add your own hook family
opener: Guys... I found this app. (pause) You need to see this.
energy: genuine discovery, not a pitch — the creator found something and opened the camera
structure: proof on screen (phone closeup / screen recording)
casual CTA in the creator's own voice
example_lines: Why did nobody tell me this?
anti_pattern: Revealing more than one capability, or copy that reads as written rather than spoken.
compliance: every claim verified true and legally available for the target audience/geo
